positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: I design and build software for Revenue Systems and Billing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Writing Java for the Billing team

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Created features for Charon Accounts API using Node.js with Express, Docker, and MySQL. The service is responsible for user registration, login, and account verification. User authentication and authorization is managed using JSON Web Tokens which can be independently verified and enforced by other services. Expensive password hashing operations are computed using AWS Lambdas.
• Development for Ledger Service managing stored rewards balances and transactions using Java with Spring Boot, Jersey, Docker, and Postgres. The service integrates with Paypal to cash out user account balances. Developed fraud prevention features such as user limits.
• Contributor and maintainer of RmnQL service for aggregation and stitching of user data across RMN services using Java with GraphQL. The service powers logged-in web and app pages such as Wallet, Profile, and Rewards dashboard.
• Coordinated holiday readiness load testing efforts for the entire engineering organization (47 systems, 15 teams). Communicated risks to leadership team while providing guidance to engineers and keeping projects on track. Presented holiday results at Eng All Hands.
• Worked across teams to implement In Store Cash Back program in Python and developed integration for push notifications.
• Created client and test suite for giftcards platform integration with inventory management service after acquisition of Giftcard Zen.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed checkout and payment features in Java and Python for the e-commerce team.
• Migrated critical payments functionality from monolithic legacy app to standalone API, using RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging with third party payment gateways.
• Implemented cart discount rules engine as a microservice using Python with Tornado.
• Improved international web and native app feature parity for checkout and payment flow.
• Implemented new shipping methods with configuration support in Admin app.
• Improved monthly subscription box processes to allow user customized sample choice to integrate seamlessly from product allocation to creation of warehouse shipment files.

positions.title: Lead Back-End Engineer
positions.description:
• Built core APIs for website and mobile applications using Java with Jersey framework.
• Developed content syndication features that required integration with third party APIs such as Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter using OAuth 2.0.
• Utilized MySQL for persistence with Memcached and ElasticSearch for quick retrieval.
• Led test automation efforts and built custom test plans for QA team on all new features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Used Play2 with Scala and MySQL to build RESTful API for reporting and analytics suite.
• Developed Tapestry Google Analytics plugin for Android using Java with Gradle.
• Collaborated with Adobe developers on SiteCatalyst analytics plugin using Javascript.
• Development for SDK that enables third parties to integrate with device graph in real-time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed RESTful web services in Java for Data Integrator SaaS application.
• Collaborated with cross-functional Agile Scrum team to develop Data Quality tool in Scala.
• Unit and integration testing using JUnit4, Specs, SoapUI with Sonar to measure coverage.
• Used Blueprint (OSGi) XML-based framework for inversion of control.
• Utilized Jenkins for continuous integration and Maven for dependency management.
